meta.description: Marts completeness, raw-to-mart reconciliation and reporting sanity for the run's date (PRD 9.4).
meta.severity_policy: CRITICAL fails the task; WARN logs and continues (PRD 9.5). Unknown severity defaults to CRITICAL.
meta.templating: Strings containing {placeholders} are rendered by runner.py from the run context (ds, ds_plus_1, ds_plus_2, project, dataset, raw_dataset, marts_dataset, clause_*).
meta.assumptions: rpt_channel_performance_daily uses stat_date as its date column (per DESIGN incremental-strategy table; PRD 8.3 only states the date x channel grain) and fct_web_events is the PRD 8.3 marts events fact name. Reconciliation queries are zero-row queries: a returned row means the raw and marts values differ, so ExpectTableRowCountToEqual(0) is CRITICAL.
meta.cost_notes: In scope=partition every query is filtered to the run's date; in scope=full the same checks run over whole tables for the initial load.

batches.name: dim_date_no_gaps
batches.sql: SELECT missing_date FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY((SELECT MIN(date) FROM `{project}.{marts_dataset}.dim_date`), (SELECT MAX(date) FROM `{project}.{marts_dataset}.dim_date`))) AS missing_date LEFT JOIN `{project}.{marts_dataset}.dim_date` d ON d.date = missing_date WHERE d.date IS NULL

batches.name: recon_ads_spend_usd
batches.sql: SELECT 1 AS check_name FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x WHERE (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(spend_usd), -1) FROM `{project}.{marts_dataset}.fct_ad_performance_daily` WHERE {clause_spend_date}) <> (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(spend_usd), -1) FROM `{project}.{raw_dataset}.raw_ads_campaign_daily` WHERE {clause_spend_date})

batches.name: recon_ads_clicks
batches.sql: SELECT 1 AS check_name FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x WHERE (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(clicks), -1) FROM `{project}.{marts_dataset}.fct_ad_performance_daily` WHERE {clause_spend_date}) <> (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(clicks), -1) FROM `{project}.{raw_dataset}.raw_ads_campaign_daily` WHERE {clause_spend_date})

batches.name: recon_web_events
batches.sql: SELECT 1 AS check_name FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x WHERE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) FROM `{project}.{marts_dataset}.fct_web_events` WHERE {clause_event_date}) <> (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) FROM `{project}.{raw_dataset}.raw_ga4_events` WHERE {clause_event_date})

batches.name: recon_youtube_views
batches.sql: SELECT 1 AS check_name FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x WHERE (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(views), -1) FROM `{project}.{marts_dataset}.fct_youtube_video_daily` WHERE {clause_video_date}) <> (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(views), -1) FROM `{project}.{raw_dataset}.raw_youtube_video_daily` WHERE {clause_video_date})

batches.name: recon_sessions
batches.sql: SELECT 1 AS check_name FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x WHERE (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sessions), 0) FROM `{project}.{marts_dataset}.rpt_channel_performance_daily` WHERE {clause_stat_date}) <> (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM `{project}.{raw_dataset}.raw_ga4_events` WHERE {clause_event_date})
